summary: Frontend E2E retest after useAnimatedReaction fix. All 5 requested flows work: analyze -> scorecard with animated dual gauges + verdict + trait pills; Save to History (button shows 'Saved'); History list shows saved item; tapping item opens read-only scorecard; delete removes item. All backend API calls return 200 (POST /api/analyze, POST /api/history, GET /api/history, GET /api/history/{id}, DELETE /api/history/{id}). No red screen, no useAnimatedReactions crash. One MEDIUM UX issue on Expo web preview only: a React DOM warning ('Invalid DOM property `transform-origin`' from react-native-svg <Circle origin=...>) triggers Expo LogBox overlay that intercepts taps on the Save/Share buttons, forcing a programmatic click during testing. This will not appear on native iOS/Android but degrades the web preview experience.

ui_bugs.issue: React web renders `origin` prop as `transform-origin` DOM attribute -> console error -> Expo LogBox red overlay appears at bottom of screen and, when expanded, blocks Save/Share button taps in the web preview. Native platforms unaffected.

react_native_issues.issue: `origin={`${SIZE/2}, ${SIZE/2}`}` prop causes web-only DOM property warning. Consider using `originX`/`originY` numeric props or wrapping in a rotated <G> group instead.

action_items: Fix the react-native-svg web rendering warning in /app/frontend/src/components/dual-gauge.tsx: replace `origin={`${SIZE/2}, ${SIZE/2}`}` on the two <Circle>/<AnimatedCircle> elements with `originX={SIZE/2} originY={SIZE/2}` (or wrap in a rotated <G>) so the LogBox overlay does not appear on web preview and cover the sticky action bar.
critical_code_review_comments: dual-gauge.tsx: `origin` string prop on Circle is not web-safe; prefer originX/originY. Otherwise the reanimated + svg logic is now correct.
scorecard.tsx: Save button click target is partially overlapped by Expo LogBox on web when SVG warning fires; consider silencing this specific warning or fixing the root cause.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (5/5 requested flows verified via network + UI assertions)

seed_data_creation: One transient history entry created and cleaned up during test (POST then DELETE, verified 0 items remaining).
context_for_next_testing_agent: The `useAnimatedReactions` -> `useAnimatedReaction` fix is verified working. Gauge values animate correctly (observed 18/82, 12/83). All Save/History/Delete round-trips confirmed via network responses. Only remaining issue is a react-native-svg web-only DOM warning that spawns an Expo LogBox overlay intercepting taps on the sticky action bar during web-preview testing; on native devices this warning path does not run. If retesting on web, either hide LogBox via CSS/JS before interacting with save-btn or dispatch clicks programmatically.
rca_of_issue: Root cause of LogBox-blocking-tap symptom: react-native-svg's web build forwards the string `origin` prop unchanged to the underlying DOM node, and React 19 treats `transform-origin` as an unknown DOM property (should be camelCase `transformOrigin`). This raises a `console.error` on every render, which Expo's LogBox surfaces as an overlay at the bottom of the screen. The overlay covers the sticky CTA bar in scorecard.tsx, so pointer events on the Save/Share buttons hit the overlay instead. Reproduction: open /scorecard on web -> observe red toast at bottom -> tap Save -> nothing happens (toast expands instead). Mitigation: change `origin={`${SIZE/2}, ${SIZE/2}`}` to `originX={SIZE/2}` and `originY={SIZE/2}` on both Circle and AnimatedCircle in dual-gauge.tsx (lines ~100 and ~113).
